title: Special coordinate is determined by the Z-variable
statement: Fix a deterministic protocol $p$ for disjointness inputs of length $n$, and recall that the $Z$-variable of a hard-distribution sample $\omega$ records the tuple $(M, T, X_{<T}, Y_{>T})$ consisting of the protocol's transcript on the input generated by $\omega$, the special coordinate $T$, and the padded bit-vectors of Alice's input before $T$ and Bob's input after $T$. If two hard-distribution samples $\omega$ and $\omega'$ yield the same value $z$ of this $Z$-variable, then they select the same special coordinate; that is, $\omega.T = \omega'.T$.
hypotheses_covered: a fixed protocol p for length-n disjointness
two hard-distribution samples ω and ω'
replaced: Two samples in the same $Z$ fiber have the same special coordinate.
